purpose: Test the first current, named SH0ES branch available at observation level: whether the 2024 SMC Cepheid anchor reproduces its published period-luminosity relation, is dominated by one star, gains transferable precision from same-sample geometry fitting, or shows a period break after accounting for the scanned breakpoint.

derivedQuantityGate.identityRule: All 88 published m_H_W values must be reproducible from named columns before any influence or model-selection claim is opened.

singleCepheidInfluenceGate.estimand: Fixed-slope magnitude at logP=1 after excluding OGLE-1455
singleCepheidInfluenceGate.rule: No single retained Cepheid may change the pivoted zero point by 0.01 mag or more under exact leave-one-out refitting.

geometryTransferGate.noGeometry: Use the published three-filter Wesenheit magnitude plus CRNL but no line-of-sight correction.
geometryTransferGate.externalGeometry: Apply the detached-eclipsing-binary plane d=3.086*x-4.248*y+d_SMC from Equation 4.
geometryTransferGate.sameSampleGeometry: Fit an affine tangent-plane correction to the retained Cepheids, reporting both training and leave-one-out prediction RMS.
geometryTransferGate.rule: A lower training scatter from same-sample geometry is not evidence of transfer. It is material only if leave-one-out RMS improves on the externally fixed DEB geometry by at least 0.005 mag.

breakSearchGate.sample: 87 Cepheids after the declared OGLE-1455 exclusion
breakSearchGate.localStatistic: Absolute difference of short- and long-period OLS slopes divided by their separate classical standard errors in quadrature.
breakSearchGate.null: One linear period-luminosity relation with Gaussian residuals at the fitted RMS and the observed logP values.
breakSearchGate.rule: A period break is admitted only when the maximum scanned local statistic has a parametric-bootstrap global p-value below 0.01.

reportedAlternatives: free rather than LMC-fixed slope, compared at logP=1
use the externally fixed DEB geometry
change the Wesenheit coefficient from 0.386 to 0.362 only after removing an internally fitted period-color relation
analysisChoiceEnvelope.warning: Applying a different Wesenheit coefficient directly to total color is not an admissible host-specific dust test because intrinsic Cepheid color must first be separated from color excess.

claimBoundary: This audit can test the named SMC photometric sub-branch and its finite-sample/model-selection stability. It cannot remove SMC from the current global distance ladder or calculate a covariance-preserving SMC effect on H0 because the current global design matrix and covariance ancestry remain unreleased.
